Senses.Explanation: This phrase belongs to the recorded exchange between Pang Yun and Yaoshan and to later comments on their handling of one item at a time. Pang Yun says that picking up one and putting down one is not yet a good hand; Yaoshan then repeats the same words and calls it exactly a good hand. Independent collections preserve both opposed predicates around the identical phrase, while later comments speak of picking up and putting down freely.
